RRB Junior Engineer JE CBT-2 Answer Key 2026

Post Date: July 11, 2026

11:57 am

Railway Recruitment Board (Ministry of Railways) has released the CBT-2 Answer Key on its official website for the recruitment of Junior Engineer (JE) Posts. The exam was conducted on 02 July 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 12 December 2025. Candidates Can Also Check their CBT-2 Answer Key using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. (Advt.No. CEN 05/2025)

Application Fee

  • For General / OBC / EWS : ₹ 500/-
  • For SC / ST / EBC : ₹ 250/-

    • Debit Card
    • Credit Card
    • Internet Banking
    • IMPS
    • Cash Card / Mobile Wallet
